form.title: FTB 3803 — Parents' Election to Report Child's Interest and Dividends

fields.label: Your Social Security Number (S S N) or Individual Taxpayer Identification Numbers (I T I N) (9 digits).
fields.pdfWidgetName: Your Social Security Number (S S N) or Individual Taxpayer Identification Numbers (I T I N) (9 digits)

fields.label: Child's S S N or I T I N (9 digits).
fields.pdfWidgetName: Child's S S N or I T I N (9 digits)

fields.label: If more than one form F T B 3803 is attached, check here.
fields.pdfWidgetName: If more than one form F T B 3803 is attached, check here

fields.label: Part I, Line 1a. Enter your child's taxable interest income.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Part I, Line 1a. Enter your child's taxable interest income

fields.label: Line 1b. Enter your child's tax-exempt interest income. Do not include this amount on line 1a.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 1b. Enter your child's tax-exempt interest income. Do not include this amount on line 1a

fields.label: Line 2. Enter your child's ordinary dividends. If none, enter 0. If your child received any dividends as a nominee, see instructions.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 2. Enter your child's ordinary dividends. If none, enter 0. If your child received any dividends as a nominee, see instructions

fields.label: Line 3. Enter your child's capital gain distributions. If your child received any capital gain distributions as a nominee, see instructions.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 3. Enter your child's capital gain distributions. If your child received any capital gain distributions as a nominee, see instructions

fields.label: Line 4. Add line 1a, line 2, and line 3. If the total is $2,700 or less, skip line 5 and line 6 and go to line 7. If the total is $13,500 or more, do not file this form. Your child must file his or her own return to report the income.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 4. Add line 1a, line 2, and line 3. If the total is $2,700 or less, skip line 5 and line 6 and go to line 7. If the total is $13,500 or more, do not file this form. Your child must file his or her own return to report the income

fields.label: Line 6. Subtract line 5 from line 4. See instructions for where to report this amount Go to line 7 below.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 6. Subtract line 5 from line 4. See instructions for where to report this amount Go to line 7 below

fields.label: Part II, Line 7. Amount not taxed. Enter 1,350.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Part II, Line 7. Amount not taxed. Enter 1,350

fields.label: Line 8. Subtract line 7 from line 4. If zero or less, enter 0.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 8. Subtract line 7 from line 4. If zero or less, enter 0

fields.label: Line 9. Tax. Is the amount on line 8 less than $1,350? No. Enter $14.00 here and see the Note below. Yes. Multiply line 8 by 1% (.01). Enter the result here and see the Note below.
